pages.text: An emergency reserve. The $(item)Stable Chemical Battery$() is made full and sealed, and while it is sealed it is $(thing)inert$(): it gives nothing to the wire and keeps its charge, in place or broken out and carried as an item, for as long as you like.$(br2)Its $(thing)first redstone signal$() breaks the seal for good, with a fizz. From then on it powers its circuit until it is flat.

pages.title: Use once
pages.text: It $(thing)cannot be recharged$(): no solar panel, charge controller or generator puts anything back into it. Once it is flat, it is done.$(br2)Wire one to a station with a button beside it, for the day the sun goes and the other batteries run down.
